posts.title: How much videographers, photographers, editors and SMM cost in Kazakhstan in 2026
posts.metaTitle: Videographer, photographer and SMM prices in Kazakhstan 2026
posts.metaDesc: What videographers, mobile videographers, photographers, video editors and SMM cost in Almaty and Astana: price ranges as of October 2026 and what drives them.
posts.lead: Prices for creative services in Kazakhstan vary tenfold: one videographer in the classifieds charges ₸10,000, another ₸450,000. We collected public price lists from platforms, classifieds and agencies as of October 2026 to show the real ranges and explain what the price is made of.

ps: Below are ranges for Almaty and Astana. The lower end is beginners and simple tasks, the upper end is experienced professionals and production-level work. Most orders land in the middle.

head: Specialist
Priced by

rows: Social media management by an agency

notes: Sources: Profi.kz price lists (Almaty and Astana), Kaspi Obyavleniya and OLX listings, studio and SMM agency websites — as of October 2026. Ad budget, studio rental and out-of-town travel are not included.

ps: Hourly rates for camera operators on Profi.kz in Almaty range from ₸5,000 to ₸100,000. Experienced videographers usually quote ₸15,000–50,000 per hour of filming. A studio may charge about ₸35,000 per hour without editing, and an agency shift of 4–8 hours starts at ₸139,200.

Kaspi listings more often offer packages: a reels shoot with simple editing costs ₸15,000–35,000, a turnkey ad or event video ₸30,000 to ₸450,000. Mobile videographers on Profi.kz charge ₸10,000–40,000 per hour.
Always check whether editing is included: it is often a separate line.

Portrait, commercial and content photography in Almaty costs ₸15,000–50,000 per hour, product photography ₸12,000–35,000 per hour, food photography ₸10,000–30,000. Retouching is priced separately: ₸500 to ₸10,000 per photo depending on complexity.
If you need a studio, rental adds from ₸8,000 per hour.

Editing one reel costs from ₸3,500 with beginner editors. On Profi.kz in Almaty the range is ₸5,000–48,000 per video. Length, color grading, graphics, subtitles and the number of revisions push the price up.
One-off SMM services on Profi.kz start at ₸8,000, Instagram promotion costs ₸16,000–100,000, targeted ad setup ₸20,000–120,000. The ad budget is paid separately.

Social media management by an agency in Almaty starts at ₸139,000 per month; full packages with content and ads cost ₸350,000–700,000. Freelancers usually charge less than agencies, but compare the scope: posts, reels, stories, filming, reports.

Simple tasks — a banner, a cover, a post — start at ₸2,800 on Profi.kz, simple animation from motion designers at ₸2,490. A logo, brand identity or complex animation is quoted per project: ask for an estimate with stages and the number of options.

faq.a: Public price lists show ₸5,000 to ₸100,000 per hour; experienced videographers usually charge ₸15,000–50,000. Editing is usually paid separately.

faq.a: A mobile videographer's package with filming and simple editing costs about ₸15,000–35,000. A videographer working at production level with a script will charge more.

posts.lead: In Kazakhstan people look for videographers, designers and SMM specialists on classifieds, service marketplaces and freelance exchanges. We compared six platforms: how you find a creator, whether there are portfolios and reviews, who pays and for what. To be upfront: ChikChirik is our product, so we also point out where other platforms are stronger.

ps: For a one-off shoot needed tomorrow, Kaspi Obyavleniya and OLX are fastest: hundreds of listings, but you search and call creators yourself. If vetting and payment through the service matter — Naimi. For design and SMM with a focus on reviews — Profi.kz. If you want to describe your task once and compare portfolios of creatives who respond — ChikChirik. For full-time hiring — hh.kz.

notes: Data as of October 21, 2026, from the platforms' public pages in Almaty. “Not stated” means the information is not publicly available. Terms change — check on the platform's website.

ps: We looked at the platforms' public pages without signing up and compared them on five questions: how you find a creator, whether you can see their work, whether there are reviews, who pays the platform and for what, and whether there are niche creative categories — mobile videographers, motion, AI creators.

The biggest choice: the search for “videographer” alone returns 335 listings across Kazakhstan, and the photo and video section for the Almaty region has more than a thousand. Posting listings is free, and there is no paid promotion in the Services section.
Downsides: you search and call creators yourself, there are no reviews, and starting prices vary widely — from ₸5,000 to ₸450,000. Good for a one-off shoot when you need it fast and cheap.

Similar to Kaspi: listings by city and district, with a Kazakh version. Handy if you need someone nearby. The downsides are the same — no responses to your task and no reviews, so you judge quality by the listing photos and chat.

A service marketplace: you leave a request, specialists quote a price themselves, and payment goes through the app. Specialists pass four checks: registration, a test, an interview and document verification.
The downside for creative tasks: they are only part of a large catalog — videographers, for example, sit under “IT and freelance”. Good if vetting and payment through the service matter to you.

The Kazakhstan version of Profi.ru. Its freelance section in Almaty lists 2,636 specialists with an average rating of 4.81 from 254 reviews, passport checks, and it is free for clients. Its strengths are reviews and clear starting prices: SMM from ₸26,000, motion design from ₸2,490.
The downside: the focus is on IT, copywriting and marketing; video and photo are in other sections. Good for design, SMM and copy when reviews matter.

Kwork, Freelancehunt, allfreelance.kz and similar exchanges are handy for remote tasks: design, editing, motion. Downsides: most are not Kazakh, there are few creators for shoots in Almaty and Astana, and safe-deal payments usually carry a commission. Good if location doesn't matter.
Not for one-off projects but for full-time hiring or long contracts: you post a vacancy or search CVs. If you need a videographer or SMM manager on staff, this is the place.

An app for creative tasks only: videographers, mobile videographers, video editors, photographers, designers, motion designers, SMM, AI creators and drone operators. You post a task, creators with portfolios respond, and you discuss details in chat. App data as of October 2026: 2,149 specialists, 636 published projects, 17 responses per active project on average. Free for clients.

It has weak spots too: payment goes directly to the creator, there is no safe deal; the service is young, so there are fewer reviews than on Profi.kz for now. Good for shoots and business content in Almaty and Astana when you want to compare several creators by their work.

posts.title: How to write a brief for a videographer: template and example
posts.metaTitle: Videographer brief: template and example | ChikChirik
posts.metaDesc: How to write a brief for a videographer: goal, format, timing and budget. A ready-to-use template, a filled-in example and common mistakes.
posts.lead: A good brief saves time and money: the videographer understands the task right away, quotes an accurate price and doesn’t spend days on questions. Here’s what to include in a brief, plus a ready template you can copy and paste into your task on ChikChirik.

ps: Without a brief, a videographer answers “it depends” and guesses the price. With a brief, they immediately see the scope, the equipment needed and the timeline. You get accurate responses and compare offers on the same terms.
A brief doesn’t have to be long. Answering the eight questions below takes 10–15 minutes.

sections.h: What to include in a brief
items: Goal of the video. What it’s for: sales, awareness, a product presentation, an event recap.
Where the video will be used. Instagram and TikTok — vertical 9:16, YouTube and websites — horizontal 16:9, ads or a screen at an event.
Format and length. For example: 3 reels of 30 seconds or one 1–2 minute video.
What and where to film. Location, people on camera, a product or a process. Whether a studio is needed.
Shoot date and time. The exact day and how many hours the shoot will take.
Editing and deliverables. Whether you need editing, colour grading, music, subtitles, how many rounds of revisions and whether you need the raw footage.
References. 2–3 videos whose style you like — clearer than any description.
Budget and deadline. Your budget range and the date you need the finished video.

ps: Copy the template, fill it in and paste it into your task description on ChikChirik — videographers will see all the details at once.

example: Goal of the video: attract guests to a new coffee shop.
Where it will be published: Instagram and TikTok.
Format and length: 4 vertical reels of 20–30 seconds.
What we film: the interior, coffee being made, baristas and guests.
Location and shoot date: a coffee shop in Almaty, Saturday, 10:00–13:00.
Editing and deliverables: edited with music and subtitles, 2 rounds of revisions.
References (links): 2 reels from other coffee shops.

items: No goal — the videographer films something “beautiful” but not what you need for sales.
No format — the video was shot horizontally when you needed vertical reels.
No references — you and the videographer imagine different styles.
Revisions not discussed — every change turns into an argument.
No budget — you get responses with prices far from what you expected.

faq.q: How long does it take to write a brief?
faq.a: 10–15 minutes if you answer the questions in the template. That’s enough to get accurate responses.

faq.q: What if I don’t know which format I need?
faq.a: Say where the video will be published and the videographer will suggest the format. Reels and TikTok usually need a vertical 9:16 video.

faq.q: Do I need a brief for a simple shoot?
faq.a: Yes, even a short one: goal, format, date and budget. A few lines prevent misunderstandings.

faq.q: Can I change the brief after work starts?
faq.a: You can, but discuss it with the videographer first: changes may affect the timeline and the price.
